# DataForSEO Technologies Summary by Region API

Number of websites using given technologies, broken down by country, language and category.

Request fields follow the official DataForSEO `/v3/domain_analytics/technologies/technologies_summary/live` task schema (one task per call). The response is DataForSEO's original JSON; results are in `tasks[].result`.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/dataforseo/v3/domain_analytics/technologies/technologies_summary/live" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"technologies": ["Nginx"], "countries": ["US"]}'
```

## Parameters

The JSON body is forwarded to the upstream endpoint. Main fields:

| Name | Description |
|---|---|
| `technologies` | Array of technology names, e.g. ["Nginx"]. |
| `countries` | Optional array of country codes. |
| `keywords` | Optional keywords to match in site titles. |

## Reference

- Official docs: https://docs.dataforseo.com/v3/domain_analytics/technologies/technologies_summary/live/

## Pricing

Billed at the actual cost of each call, about $0.0132 for the request above. The cost grows with the number of rows, targets or tokens a call returns. Failed calls are not charged. Searches with no results are billed at their actual cost.
